title: Assistant/Associate/Professor of Economics
description:
The Department of Economics at the University of Michigan in Ann
Arbor invites applications for a full-time, endowed tenure-track
position and tenure track Assistant Professor positions in any
field of economics to begin August 25, 2027.

Senior applicants:
This is a university year appointment and will be at the tenured
level of Associate Professor or Professor, commensurate with the
successful candidate's qualifications and experience. Candidates
should demonstrate excellence in scholarly productivity and impact
in Economics.

Duties include: teaching and research in Economics, advising
students and providing service to the department and university.
Ph.D. in Economics or related field required. Research capacity and
teaching ability serve as the primary criteria for selection.

Applicants must submit curriculum vitae, a statement of teaching
philosophy and experience, a statement of current and future
research plans, and evidence of teaching excellence to
econ-apply@umich.edu.

Junior applicants:
This is a university-year appointment at the assistant professor
level.
Duties include teaching and conducting research in economics,
advising students, and providing service to the department and
university. A Ph.D. in Economics or a related field is required by
the start date of the position.

Applicants must submit a current curriculum vitae, job market
paper, three reference letters, a statement of teaching philosophy
and experience, a statement of current and future research plans,
and evidence of teaching excellence to the department's Assistant
Professor of Economics - Any Field job posting on EconJobMarket at
https://www.econjobmarket.org.


First consideration will be given to applications submitted by
November 7, 2026. Applications will continue to be considered until
the position is filled.

Employment will require a successful criminal background check and
candidates must meet all degree requirements prior to the start
date of the position. Senior candidates will also be required to
complete a self-disclosure form and an authorization to release
information form, as well as undergo an institutional reference
check regarding any misconduct. The University of Michigan is
supportive of the needs of dual career couples and is an Equal
Opportunity Employer.
